params.message:
Ask manages sources for the person who is asking

Ask looked things up and changed nothing; managing sources was the Sources
page, one click per source, and the 24 Belgian sources that wait for the
desk were 24 clicks. Ask now has the moves as tools, for a team member who
is signed in: the scorecard of a trial, start a trial, mute, unmute, turn
down, and place a source in a country, in a list of up to fifty.

A change is shown first and runs only when confirmed, because Ask reads
what the web wrote. One function decides what is allowed (the team looks,
an editor or an admin changes, admitting a source stays with a person and
the recommendation is kept), and every change and refusal is written down
with the person, Ask and the conversation. A guest's Ask gets none of it.

Portal: In het Observatory kan je Ask nu vragen om bronnen te beheren: een proef starten, dempen of het land zetten, na jouw bevestiging.
